import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# NYC Taxi Zone boundaries (approximate)
MANHATTAN_MIN_LON, MANHATTAN_MAX_LON = -74.02, -73.93
MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT, MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT = 40.70, 40.80

# Define NYC landmarks coordinates
NYC_CENTER = (-73.9857, 40.7589)
JFK_AIRPORT = (-73.7781, 40.6413)
LGA_AIRPORT = (-73.8740, 40.7769)
EWRAIRPORT = (-74.1745, 40.6895)

# Load data - use full training data as described in the data overview
train_labels = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_data = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Define Haversine distance function
def haversine_np(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2):
    """Calculate the great circle distance between two points on earth (decimal degrees)"""
    lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2 = map(np.radians, [lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2])
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return 6371 * c  # Radius of earth in kilometers


def compute_distance_to_point(lon, lat, point_lon, point_lat):
    """Compute distance from point to a fixed location"""
    return haversine_np(lon, lat, point_lon, point_lat)


def feature_engineering(df, is_train=True):
    """Engineer features for the dataset"""
    df = df.copy()

    # Parse datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)

    # Time features
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["day_of_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year

    # Haversine distance
    df["distance"] = haversine_np(
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
    )

    # Absolute differences for Manhattan distance proxy
    df["abs_diff_lon"] = np.abs(df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"])
    df["abs_diff_lat"] = np.abs(df["pickup_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"])

    # Manhattan distance
    df["manhatten_dist"] = df["abs_diff_lon"] + df["abs_diff_lat"]

    # Direction features
    df["direction_rad"] = np.arctan2(
        df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"],
    )
    df["direction_sin"] = np.sin(df["direction_rad"])
    df["direction_cos"] = np.cos(df["direction_rad"])

    # Distance to major NYC landmarks
    df["pickup_to_jfk"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["pickup_longitude"], df["pickup_latitude"], JFK_AIRPORT[0], JFK_AIRPORT[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_jfk"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["dropoff_longitude"], df["dropoff_latitude"], JFK_AIRPORT[0], JFK_AIRPORT[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_lga"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["pickup_longitude"], df["pickup_latitude"], LGA_AIRPORT[0], LGA_AIRPORT[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_lga"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["dropoff_longitude"], df["dropoff_latitude"], LGA_AIRPORT[0], LGA_AIRPORT[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_ewr"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["pickup_longitude"], df["pickup_latitude"], EWRAIRPORT[0], EWRAIRPORT[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_ewr"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["dropoff_longitude"], df["dropoff_latitude"], EWRAIRPORT[0], EWRAIRPORT[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_nyc_center"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["pickup_longitude"], df["pickup_latitude"], NYC_CENTER[0], NYC_CENTER[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_nyc_center"] = compute_distance_to_point(
        df["dropoff_longitude"], df["dropoff_latitude"], NYC_CENTER[0], NYC_CENTER[1]
    )

    # Zone-based features
    df["pickup_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["pickup_longitude"] > MANHATTAN_MIN_LON)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < MANHATTAN_MAX_LON)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] > MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT)
    ).astype(int)
    df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["dropoff_longitude"] > MANHATTAN_MIN_LON)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < MANHATTAN_MAX_LON)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] > MANHATTAN_MIN_LAT)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < MANHATTAN_MAX_LAT)
    ).astype(int)

    # Cross-zone features
    df["manhattan_to_airport"] = (
        df["pickup_in_manhattan"]
        * (
            (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 1)
            | (df["dropoff_to_lga"] < 1)
            | (df["dropoff_to_ewr"] < 1)
        )
    ).astype(int)
    df["airport_to_manhattan"] = (
        df["dropoff_in_manhattan"]
        * (
            (df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 1)
            | (df["pickup_to_lga"] < 1)
            | (df["pickup_to_ewr"] < 1)
        )
    ).astype(int)

    # Airport-to-airport trips
    df["airport_trip"] = (
        (
            (df["pickup_to_jfk"] < 1)
            | (df["pickup_to_lga"] < 1)
            | (df["pickup_to_ewr"] < 1)
        )
        & (
            (df["dropoff_to_jfk"] < 1)
            | (df["dropoff_to_lga"] < 1)
            | (df["dropoff_to_ewr"] < 1)
        )
    ).astype(int)

    # Distance ratio features
    df["distance_ratio"] = df["distance"] / (df["manhatten_dist"] + 1e-6)

    # Time-based distance features
    df["distance_per_hour"] = df["distance"] / (df["hour"] + 1)

    # Peak hour indicators
    df["peak_hour"] = (
        ((df["hour"] >= 8) & (df["hour"] <= 10))
        | ((df["hour"] >= 16) & (df["hour"] <= 19))
    ).astype(int)

    # Weekend indicator
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)

    # Late night surcharge indicator
    df["late_night"] = ((df["hour"] >= 20) | (df["hour"] < 6)).astype(int)

    # Fill NaN distances with 0
    df["distance"] = df["distance"].fillna(0)

    # Drop datetime and temporary columns
    df = df.drop(["pickup_datetime", "direction_rad"], axis=1)

    return df


# Apply feature engineering to train and test data
train_df = feature_engineering(train_labels, is_train=True)
test_df = feature_engineering(test_data, is_train=False)

# Clean training data
train_df = train_df[train_df["fare_amount"] > 0]
train_df = train_df[train_df["fare_amount"] < 500]
train_df = train_df[train_df["distance"] > 0.1]
train_df = train_df[train_df["distance"] < 200]
train_df = train_df[train_df["passenger_count"] > 0]
train_df = train_df[train_df["passenger_count"] <= 6]

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["fare_amount", "key"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df["fare_amount"]
test_X = test_df[feature_cols]

# Split for validation (proper hold-out)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Train model with validation set for early stopping (but not for final model refit)
params = {
    "iterations": 1000,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "depth": 10,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 3,
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "eval_metric": "RMSE",
    "random_seed": 42,
    "use_best_model": True,
    "verbose": False,
    "thread_count": -1,
}

# Train with validation for early stopping
model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)
model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=(X_val, y_val))

# Validate
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Train final model on full data WITHOUT use_best_model (no early stopping)
final_params = params.copy()
final_params["use_best_model"] = False
final_model = CatBoostRegressor(**final_params)
final_model.fit(X, y, verbose=False)

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = final_model.predict(test_X)

# Create submission file using test_df['key'] and test_preds
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_preds})

# Save submission file
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Final RMSE (validation): {val_rmse:.4f}")
